report: Progressive dyspnea, hypoxia, perihilar ground-glass opacities and LDH 916 U/L suggested Pneumocystis pneumonia; BAL confirmed Pneumocystis organisms with negative bacterial/fungal cultures, establishing PCP (0.98) and excluding other pneumonias and ILD. Negative HIV testing, CD4 110 cells/µL and inverted CD4:CD8 0.35 indicate PCP in a non-HIV immunocompromised host. Secondary causes (lymphoma, HTLV, autoimmunity, drugs) are unproven; idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia is the most probable cause.
